_about: Guardrails for crm.py push. Built from CRM-Track-Rebuild-Plan-2026-10-16.md and CRM-Routing-Audit-2026-10-18.md. Edit when the CRM's tracks change. Nothing here changes the CRM; it only decides what this engine refuses to do.

live_trigger_tags._about: Tags that a PUBLISHED workflow listens for as of 2026-10-18. Adding one of these is a SEND action. The engine will never add them, and refuses any batch tag that equals one.
live_trigger_tags.aio-sent: AIO - Direct Outreach Tracker: sends one email immediately
live_trigger_tags.partner-sent: AIO - Partnership Tracker: sends one email immediately

planned_track_tags._about: Track and step tags from the rebuild plan. Some trigger nothing today, but the plan reserves them for workflows, so the engine never adds them either.

suppression._about: If the existing contact matches any of these, it is skipped and the reason is recorded. Checked before every live upsert or tag add.

existing_relationship._about: An existing contact carrying any of these is already in a Morpho track, a pipeline or an old list. The engine skips them by default (reason recorded) so a lead-gen batch never re-labels a managed relationship. --update-existing adds the engine's tags only, never overwrites fields.

workflow_trigger_note: GoHighLevel workflows can be triggered by ANY 'Contact Tag added' event. The lists above are what was documented on 2026-10-18. Before every --live push, open Automation > Workflows and confirm no published workflow listens for an ICP tag, a batch tag, or any engine_tag_prefixes tag. The engine cannot read workflows with the current token (View Workflows returned 401).
